description: This header file defines the 'JsonResponses' namespace, which contains functions for generating and manipulating JSON response objects related to API error responses and status information. It includes functions for creating specific error messages such as malformed requests, path not found, no access, value out of bounds, and responses indicating unset values. It also provides utility functions for timestamp handling and JSON timestamp conversion.

methods.name: malFormedRequest
methods.description: Creates a JSON object indicating a malformed API request, with variants for different parameter sets.

methods.name: pathNotFound
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating that a requested API path was not found.

methods.name: noAccess
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a lack of access permissions.

methods.name: valueOutOfBounds
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a value is out of acceptable bounds.

methods.name: notSetResponse
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a value was not set.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp as a string.

methods.name: addTimeStampToJSON
methods.description: Adds a timestamp field to a JSON object.

methods.name: convertJSONTimeStampToISO8601
methods.description: Converts timestamp fields within a JSON object to ISO8601 format.

methods.name: getTimeStampZero
methods.description: Returns a zero or null timestamp string.
